verses.original: וּמָרְדֳּכַ֗י יָדַע֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשָׂ֔ה וַיִּקְרַ֤ע מָרְדֳּכַי֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ שַׂ֖ק וָאֵ֑פֶר וַיֵּצֵא֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֔יר וַיִּזְעַ֛ק זְעָקָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה וּמָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·rə·do·ḵay yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer na·‘ă·śāh way·yiq·ra‘ mā·rə·do·ḵay ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw way·yil·baš śaq wā·’ê·p̄er way·yê·ṣê bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘îr way·yiz·‘aq zə·‘ā·qāh ḡə·ḏō·lāh ū·mā·rāh
verses.literal: When Mordecai learned of all that had happened he tore his clothes put on sackcloth and ashes and went out into the middle of the city wailing . . . loudly and bitterly

verses.original: וַיָּב֕וֹא עַ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י שַֽׁעַר־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין לָב֛וֹא אֶל־ שַׁ֥עַר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּלְב֥וּשׁ שָֽׂק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w ‘aḏ lip̄·nê ša·‘ar- ham·me·leḵ kî ’ên lā·ḇō·w ’el- ša·‘ar ham·me·leḵ bil·ḇūš śāq
verses.literal: But he went only as . . . far as the king’s gate because the law prohibited anyone wearing sackcloth from entering . . . that gate

verses.original: וּבְכָל־ מְדִינָ֣ה וּמְדִינָ֗ה מְקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דְּבַר־ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְדָתוֹ֙ מַגִּ֔יעַ אֵ֤בֶל גָּדוֹל֙ לַיְּהוּדִ֔ים וְצ֥וֹם וּבְכִ֖י וּמִסְפֵּ֑ד שַׂ֣ק וָאֵ֔פֶר יֻצַּ֖ע לָֽרַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḵāl mə·ḏî·nāh ū·mə·ḏî·nāh mə·qō·wm ’ă·šer də·ḇar- ham·me·leḵ wə·ḏā·ṯōw mag·gî·a‘ ’ê·ḇel gā·ḏō·wl lay·yə·hū·ḏîm wə·ṣō·wm ū·ḇə·ḵî ū·mis·pêḏ śaq wā·’ê·p̄er yuṣ·ṣa‘ lā·rab·bîm
verses.literal: In every province . . . to which the king’s command and edict came there was great mourning among the Jews They fasted wept and lamented and many lay in sackcloth and ashes

verses.original: וַ֠תָּבוֹאינָה נַעֲר֨וֹת אֶסְתֵּ֤ר וְסָרִיסֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֔הּ וַתִּתְחַלְחַ֥ל הַמַּלְכָּ֖ה מְאֹ֑ד וַתִּשְׁלַ֨ח בְּגָדִ֜ים לְהַלְבִּ֣ישׁ אֶֽת־ מָרְדֳּכַ֗י וּלְהָסִ֥יר שַׂקּ֛וֹ מֵעָלָ֖יו וְלֹ֥א קִבֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tå̄·ḇō·nå̄h na·‘ă·rō·wṯ ’es·têr wə·sā·rî·se·hā way·yag·gî·ḏū lāh wat·tiṯ·ḥal·ḥal ham·mal·kāh mə·’ōḏ wat·tiš·laḥ bə·ḡā·ḏîm lə·hal·bîš ’eṯ- mā·rə·do·ḵay ū·lə·hā·sîr śaq·qōw mê·‘ā·lāw wə·lō qib·bêl
verses.literal: When Esther’s maidens and eunuchs came and told her about Mordecai the queen was overcome with distress . . . She sent clothes for Mordecai to wear instead of his sackcloth . . . but he would not accept them

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָא֩ אֶסְתֵּ֨ר לַהֲתָ֜ךְ מִסָּרִיסֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱמִ֣יד לְפָנֶ֔יהָ וַתְּצַוֵּ֖הוּ עַֽל־ מָרְדֳּכָ֑י לָדַ֥עַת מַה־ זֶּ֖ה וְעַל־ מַה־ זֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā ’es·têr la·hă·ṯāḵ mis·sā·rî·sê ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·mîḏ lə·p̄ā·ne·hā wat·tə·ṣaw·wê·hū ‘al- mā·rə·do·ḵāy lā·ḏa·‘aṯ mah- zeh wə·‘al- mah- zeh
verses.literal: Then Esther summoned Hathach one of the king’s eunuchs appointed to her and she dispatched him to Mordecai to learn what was troubling him . . . and why . . . . . .

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א הֲתָ֖ךְ אֶֽל־ מָרְדֳּכָ֑י אֶל־ רְח֣וֹב הָעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י שַֽׁעַר־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hă·ṯāḵ ’el- mā·rə·do·ḵāy ’el- rə·ḥō·wḇ hā·‘îr ’ă·šer lip̄·nê ša·‘ar- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: So Hathach went out to Mordecai in the city square in front of the king’s gate

verses.original: וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֣וֹ מָרְדֳּכַ֔י אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרָ֑הוּ וְאֵ֣ת׀ פָּרָשַׁ֣ת הַכֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר הָמָן֙ לִ֠שְׁקוֹל עַל־ גִּנְזֵ֥י הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ בַּיְּהוּדִיִּים לְאַבְּדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·geḏ- lōw mā·rə·do·ḵay ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer qā·rā·hū wə·’êṯ pā·rā·šaṯ hak·ke·sep̄ ’ă·šer ’ā·mar hā·mān liš·qō·wl ‘al- gin·zê ham·me·leḵ bay·yə·hū·ḏī·yīm lə·’ab·bə·ḏām
verses.literal: and Mordecai told him all that had happened to him including the exact amount of money that Haman had promised to pay into the royal treasury in order to destroy the Jews

verses.original: וְאֶת־ פַּתְשֶׁ֣גֶן כְּתָֽב־ הַ֠דָּת אֲשֶׁר־ נִתַּ֨ן בְּשׁוּשָׁ֤ן לְהַשְׁמִידָם֙ נָ֣תַן ל֔וֹ לְהַרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ אֶסְתֵּ֖ר וּלְהַגִּ֣יד לָ֑הּ וּלְצַוּ֣וֹת עָלֶ֗יהָ לָב֨וֹא אֶל־ הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ לְהִֽתְחַנֶּן־ ל֛וֹ וּלְבַקֵּ֥שׁ מִלְּפָנָ֖יו עַל־ עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- paṯ·še·ḡen kə·ṯāḇ- had·dāṯ ’ă·šer- nit·tan bə·šū·šān lə·haš·mî·ḏām nā·ṯan lōw lə·har·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- ’es·têr ū·lə·hag·gîḏ lāh ū·lə·ṣaw·wō·wṯ ‘ā·le·hā lā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·me·leḵ lə·hiṯ·ḥan·nen- lōw ū·lə·ḇaq·qêš mil·lə·p̄ā·nāw ‘al- ‘am·māh
verses.literal: Mordecai also gave Hathach a copy of the written decree issued in Susa for the destruction of the Jews to show and explain to Esther urging her to approach . . . the king implore his favor and plead before him for her people

verses.original: וַיָּב֖וֹא הֲתָ֑ךְ וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לְאֶסְתֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י מָרְדֳּכָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w hă·ṯāḵ way·yag·gêḏ lə·’es·têr ’êṯ diḇ·rê mā·rə·do·ḵāy
verses.literal: So Hathach went back and relayed Mordecai’s response to Esther

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֶסְתֵּר֙ לַהֲתָ֔ךְ וַתְּצַוֵּ֖הוּ אֶֽל־ מָרְדֳּכָֽי׃
verses.literal: Then Esther spoke to Hathach and instructed him to tell Mordecai

verses.original: כָּל־ עַבְדֵ֣י הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ וְעַם־ מְדִינ֨וֹת הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ יֽוֹדְעִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבֽוֹא־ אֶל־ הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֨ר הַפְּנִימִ֜ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יִקָּרֵ֗א אַחַ֤ת דָּתוֹ֙ לְהָמִ֔ית לְ֠בַד מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר יֽוֹשִׁיט־ ל֥וֹ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת־ שַׁרְבִ֥יט הַזָּהָ֖ב וְחָיָ֑ה וַאֲנִ֗י לֹ֤א נִקְרֵ֙אתי֙ לָב֣וֹא אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ זֶ֖ה שְׁלוֹשִׁ֥ים יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘aḇ·ḏê ham·me·leḵ wə·‘am- mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ yō·wḏ·‘îm ’ă·šer kāl- ’îš wə·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer yā·ḇō·w- ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mîṯ ’ă·šer lō- yiq·qā·rê ’a·ḥaṯ dā·ṯōw lə·hā·mîṯ lə·ḇaḏ mê·’ă·šer yō·wō·šîṭ- lōw ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- šar·ḇîṭ haz·zā·hāḇ wə·ḥā·yāh wa·’ă·nî lō niq·rē·ṯ lā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·me·leḵ zeh šə·lō·wō·šîm yō·wm
verses.literal: All the royal officials and the people of the king’s provinces know that one law applies to every man or woman who approaches . . . the king in the inner court without . . . being summoned that he be put to death Only if the king extends the gold scepter may that person live But I have not been summoned to appear before the king for the past thirty days
When Esther’s words were relayed to Mordecai

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מָרְדֳּכַ֖י לְהָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־ אֶסְתֵּ֑ר אַל־ תְּדַמִּ֣י בְנַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ לְהִמָּלֵ֥ט בֵּית־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִכָּל־ הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mā·rə·do·ḵay lə·hā·šîḇ ’el- ’es·têr ’al- tə·ḏam·mî ḇə·nap̄·šêḵ lə·him·mā·lêṭ bêṯ- ham·me·leḵ mik·kāl hay·yə·hū·ḏîm
verses.literal: he sent back to her this reply Do not imagine that because you are in the king’s palace you alone will escape the fate of all the Jews

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישִׁי֮ בָּעֵ֣ת הַזֹּאת֒ רֶ֣וַח וְהַצָּלָ֞ה יַעֲמ֤וֹד לַיְּהוּדִים֙ מִמָּק֣וֹם אַחֵ֔ר וְאַ֥תְּ וּבֵית־ אָבִ֖יךְ תֹּאבֵ֑דוּ וּמִ֣י יוֹדֵ֔עַ אִם־ לְעֵ֣ת כָּזֹ֔את הִגַּ֖עַתְּ לַמַּלְכֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ha·ḥă·rêš ta·ḥă·rî·šî bā·‘êṯ haz·zōṯ re·waḥ wə·haṣ·ṣā·lāh ya·‘ă·mō·wḏ lay·yə·hū·ḏîm mim·mā·qō·wm ’a·ḥêr wə·’at ū·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇîḵ tō·ḇê·ḏū ū·mî yō·w·ḏê·a‘ ’im- lə·‘êṯ kā·zōṯ hig·ga·‘at lam·mal·ḵūṯ
verses.literal: For if you remain silent . . . at this time relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place but you and your father’s house will perish And who knows if perhaps you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this
Then Esther sent this reply to Mordecai

verses.original: לֵךְ֩ כְּנ֨וֹס אֶת־ כָּל־ הַיְּהוּדִ֜ים הַֽנִּמְצְאִ֣ים בְּשׁוּשָׁ֗ן וְצ֣וּמוּ עָ֠לַי וְאַל־ תֹּאכְל֨וּ וְאַל־ תִּשְׁתּ֜וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ לַ֣יְלָה וָי֔וֹם גַּם־ אֲנִ֥י וְנַעֲרֹתַ֖י אָצ֣וּם כֵּ֑ן וּבְכֵ֞ן אָב֤וֹא אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ כַדָּ֔ת וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָבַ֖דְתִּי אָבָֽדְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ kə·nō·ws ’eṯ- kāl- hay·yə·hū·ḏîm han·nim·ṣə·’îm bə·šū·šān wə·ṣū·mū ‘ā·lay wə·’al- tō·ḵə·lū wə·’al- tiš·tū šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm lay·lāh wā·yō·wm gam- ’ă·nî wə·na·‘ă·rō·ṯay ’ā·ṣūm kên ū·ḇə·ḵên ’ā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer lō- ḵad·dāṯ wə·ḵa·’ă·šer ’ā·ḇaḏ·tî ’ā·ḇā·ḏə·tî
verses.literal: Go and assemble all the Jews who can be found in Susa and fast for me Do not eat . . . or drink for three days night or day and I and my maidens will fast as you do After that I will go to the king even though it is against the law And if I perish I perish

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוְּתָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו אֶסְתֵּֽר׃ס
verses.literal: So Mordecai went and did all that Esther had instructed him
